retired.headline: Flash Flood Warning Hits Stuart, Hobe Sound, Palm City and Coastal Martin County
retired.reason: Editor-directed removal: NWS Melbourne flash flood warning for northeastern Martin County was issued October 11, 2026 at 5:23 p.m. EDT and expired at 7:00 p.m. EDT. This article was published after expiration but presented the alert as current. Remove it from article discovery and live recovery; do not redirect it to an unrelated report.
